sourceFile: 08. BRS-161014  Report test new jig magnetize for new model 161024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but the primary changed factor and subgroup grouping are inconsistent.
issues: Changed factor wrongly says Normal vs JIG TEST with SMG Long while cited pair is SMG short.
Primary context appears new jig magnetize versus old/normal jig, not model/spec as stated.
Gauss results mix S-MG short and S-MH long without clear subgroup separation.
Jig damage statistics rely on header/partial rows and need data-row confirmation.
Several cited rows are not shown in context, limiting citation audit.
correctionPlan: Rename changed factor to new jig magnetize versus old/normal jig if supported by rows.
Separate subgroup results by magnet type: S-MG short and S-MH long.
Correct baseline and changed conditions for JIG TEST versus Normal rows.
Verify jig damage rows include actual before/after damage values, not only headers.
Retain damage, NG rate, and gauss outcomes under one validation report only after regrouping.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations are sufficient for existence but not yet sufficient for final grouping.
